extension.summary: Hears where someone speaks, to realign a subtitle file
extension.description:
Lets Kodi realign a subtitle file made for another release of a film - another intro, or a PAL copy running 4% fast - on a video that has no subtitle of its own to lay it against: Kodi listens to a few minutes of the film, or all of it when it must, and moves the lines onto the speech.
Holds Silero's voice activity model (MIT licence). Needs the allolive build of CoreELEC, which installs it when System > Yacer > Subtitles > Realign with the video first needs it.
